packages.name: Basic
packages.description: A focused engagement for one clearly defined business need.
scope: Recommended: Review one business problem and the available inputs
Recommended: Complete one agreed analysis or small improvement
deliverables: Recommended: One agreed output and handover notes
assumptions: For review: the client supplies relevant information and an approver
exclusions: Recommended boundary: additional requirements and ongoing support need separate agreement
dependencies: Confirm access to required information and availability of the client approver

packages.name: Standard
packages.description: A complete delivery cycle for a defined project.
scope: Recommended: Confirm requirements and acceptance criteria
Recommended: Develop and review one agreed solution
Recommended: Complete a review and handover
deliverables: Recommended: Agreed solution or analysis report
assumptions: For review: the client supplies relevant information and an approver
exclusions: Recommended boundary: additional requirements and ongoing support need separate agreement
dependencies: Confirm access to required information and availability of the client approver

packages.name: Premium
packages.description: An extended engagement for a project with several related requirements.
scope: Recommended: Assess related requirements and dependencies
Recommended: Deliver agreed work in reviewable phases
Recommended: Review quality and prepare handover
deliverables: Recommended: Evaluation summary and handover guide
assumptions: For review: the client supplies relevant information and an approver
exclusions: Recommended boundary: additional requirements and ongoing support need separate agreement
dependencies: Confirm access to required information and availability of the client approver

packages.name: Custom
packages.description: A tailored engagement when the project needs a different scope.
scope: Recommended: Agree a tailored list of work and acceptance criteria
assumptions: For review: the client supplies relevant information and an approver
exclusions: Recommended boundary: additional requirements and ongoing support need separate agreement
dependencies: Confirm access to required information and availability of the client approver

packages.name: Consultation
packages.description: Expert assessment and practical recommendations for a business problem.
scope: Recommended: Review the problem and relevant background
Recommended: Discuss options and recommend next steps
assumptions: For review: the client supplies relevant information and an approver
exclusions: Recommended boundary: additional requirements and ongoing support need separate agreement
dependencies: Confirm access to required information and availability of the client approver

packages.name: Sample — Data analysis
deliverables: Documented findings and data quality observations
assumptions: The client is permitted to share the supplied data
dependencies: Client provides the dataset and its field definitions

packages.name: Sample — ML prototype
scope: Train and evaluate a baseline machine-learning model
assumptions: The client provides suitable labelled data and permission to use it
dependencies: Client supplies labelled data and confirms evaluation criteria
